TEST-AI-PROMPT.title: Test AI Agent Prompt Execution
TEST-AI-PROMPT.description: Double-click this card to edit its properties, customize the command, and test the Run Agent button. You can also run the agent directly from the card using the '⚡ Run' button.
TEST-AI-PROMPT.aiPrompt: You are a test agent. Verify that you can parse this prompt successfully and that the runner executes the verification command without errors.

VERIFY-AGENT-INTEGRATION.title: Verify Agent Prompt Integration
VERIFY-AGENT-INTEGRATION.description: Double-click this card to test prompt passing and shell escaping. Running this card executes a script that asserts quotes and special characters are grouped into a single argument.
VERIFY-AGENT-INTEGRATION.aiPrompt: Verify that "double quotes" and special characters like & or | are escaped and read as a single argument.

FEEDBACK-1.title: Security: Path Traversal Protection in Electron IPC
FEEDBACK-1.description: [10-Year Desktop Shell Expert Feedback] Validate that all filesystem paths received by Electron IPC handlers in apps/desktop_shell/src/main.ts are strictly constrained within the active workspace directory to prevent arbitrary file read/write vulnerabilities.

checklists.text: Add path resolution checks in fs:read-file
Add path resolution checks in fs:write-file
Create tests asserting out-of-bounds paths are rejected

FEEDBACK-2.title: Security: Restrict DevFilesystemBridge in Vite Proxy
FEEDBACK-2.description: [10-Year Systems Engineer Feedback] Ensure that the vite dev server bridge middleware (/api/dev-fs) in vite.config.ts rejects file system read/write actions pointing outside the authorized workspace and project folders.

checklists.text: Add validation testing for API endpoints

FEEDBACK-3.title: QA/Reliability: Add Zod Runtime Schema Validation
FEEDBACK-3.description: [10-Year QA Expert Feedback] Define Zod schemas in packages/shared to validate board.json configuration files upon load. Gracefully handle malformed or version-deprecated JSON schemas without crashing the React UI.

checklists.text: Install zod in packages/shared if missing (present in package.json)
Integrate validation schema inside readBoardConfig methods

FEEDBACK-4.title: UX: Implement Board Search and Card Filtering
FEEDBACK-4.description: [10-Year Product Owner Feedback] Add a search filter input to the board header to let users filter tasks by title, description, or priority tag in real-time.

checklists.text: Add text input field to KanbanBoard header
Filter config.tasks in render loop based on search query

FEEDBACK-5.title: UI/UX: Theme Switcher & Smooth Drag Animations
FEEDBACK-5.description: [10-Year UX Engineer Feedback] Enhance index.css with custom property theme palettes (light/dark mode toggle) and add CSS transitions/transforms during drag-and-drop actions for a fluid feel.

checklists.text: Define CSS root variables for light-mode
Add theme switcher button in header
Apply transition transforms to card hover and drag state
